Atra bhāṣye guṇatrayāpekṣayā puruṣasya caturthatvavacanād anyāny api turīyavākyāni
jāgradādyavasthasattvādiguṇatrayāpekṣayā sākṣitvam eva puruṣasya turīyāvasthāṃ vadantīti
siddham / Tathā ca smaryate-- Sattvāj jāgaraṇaṃ vidyād rajasā svapnam ādiśet / Prasvāpanaṃ tū
tamasā turīyaṃ triṣu saṃtatam // iti /
Nanūktayor bhogāpavargayor guṇakāryatayā guṇaniṣṭhatvena kathaṃ puruṣasya bhogāpavargārthaṃ
dṛśyam ity ukram [=uktam ?] ity āśaṅkate-- tāv etāv iti / Yato buddhikṛtānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ
buddhikāryāvato lāghavena buddhāv eva vartamānau na tu puruṣaniṣṭhāv ityādir arthaḥ /
Dṛṣṭāntapradarśanapūrvaka�
